title: Spiral Matrix
statement: Return all elements of the m by n matrix in clockwise spiral order.
hints: Maintain four bounds: top, bottom, left, and right.
Walk right along top, down along right, left along bottom, and up along left. Shrink the bound you just finished.
Before the leftward and upward walks, check that the layer is still nonempty. A single row or column would otherwise be walked twice.

approaches.name: Visited matrix
approaches.explanation: Turn right whenever the next cell is out of bounds or visited.

approaches.name: Layer bounds
approaches.explanation: Four loops per layer. Output space is required either way.

editorial: Each layer is a rectangle. Consume its four sides and contract the bounds. The guards `top <= bottom` and `left <= right` before the reverse directions protect the middle row and the middle column of odd-sized matrices. Stop when the number of recorded cells equals m * n.
